_about: Per-file ceiling on `tsc --checkJs` errors over src/lib, src/stores and
It is empty, and that is the finished state. The ratchet landed at 92
errors across 31 files and reached zero; every entry was a @param or
@returns block that no longer described its function, in the layer whose
doc blocks are the contract callers read.
Leave the file here rather than deleting it. An empty ceiling means any
new error fails the build by name, which is the cheap way to keep the
JSDoc true now that it is. Adding an entry back is not a fix: a new error
means a doc block and a signature disagree, and the repair is to make them
agree — or, where TypeScript narrows correct JS badly, to say so with a
reason at the site, as src/types/globals.d.ts does.
Per file rather than one total, so a new error cannot hide behind a fix
somewhere else. That caught two regressions while this work was in flight:
#657's shaped-phrase literal, and a `size` param this very pass had
documented as a count when it is a size key.
